documents.title: LLM backends + router
documents.description: Four pluggable streamers (claude_cli=free real Claude via headless `claude -p`, ollama, anthropic, openrouter) behind stream_reply with active-first fallback. Loads secrets/claude_voice.env; OpenRouter key falls back to shared C:\QI\maia.db.

documents.title: Dual-brain router
documents.description: Two named brains (Claude=claude_cli / Ronald=ollama), switchable by config hard-set OR by name in chat; mishearing-tolerant address matching, persisted active state, honest no-fabrication fallback, and converse() for synchronous voice turns.

documents.title: Control API + brain UI
documents.description: FastAPI on :8720 (loopback): /health, /version, /info, /config, /bridge/health, /brain*, GET / brain toggle UI, /say smoke test. Served by the QI_ClaudeVoiceControl service.

documents.title: Realtime voice loop
documents.description: mic -> VAD/wake/PTT -> faster-whisper -> brain -> per-sentence edge-tts -> ffplay, with barge-in. Greets as the active brain and routes via brain.converse().

documents.title: TTS — Claude speaks
documents.description: Pipe text in; the PC speaks it in Claude's MALE voice. Engines: edge (neural), sapi (offline), auto. Pronunciation fix applied; ffplay playback with .NET MediaPlayer fallback.

documents.title: STT — push-to-talk
documents.description: Press-Enter push-to-talk; faster-whisper transcribes to clipboard (or --type into the focused window) for the Mode-A Code Voice bridge.

documents.title: LINE channel
documents.description: Signed webhook on :8721, owner-vs-guest routing, dual-brain owner path, voice in (Whisper) and out (edge-tts m4a), owner /commands, talking-avatar /video.

documents.title: Telegram channel
documents.description: Outbound long-poll bot, /start /reset /whoami /voice /video, per-chat memory, dual-brain routing, OGG/Opus voice notes.

documents.title: Meeting room
documents.description: Multi-participant Zoom-style room on :8722 hosted by Claude: WebSocket roster + shared transcript, per-participant voices, turn-taking, /stt, and /minutes .docx export.

documents.title: Meeting room UI
documents.description: Browser front-end for the meeting room — roster, transcript, mic capture, host avatar.

documents.title: Agent join template
documents.description: Template for another AI agent to join the meeting over WebSocket and answer only when addressed by name.

documents.title: Reply modality engine
documents.description: Decides text vs voice vs video per reply from length + moment detection; cooldown-gated video; reusable across QI bots.

documents.title: Spoken-only pronunciation
documents.description: Rewrites speech only (printed text unchanged) — e.g. 'Renne' -> 'Renee'; map editable in config.json voice.pronunciation.

documents.title: ffmpeg/ffprobe resolver

documents.title: Bridge health monitor

documents.title: Avatar video builder
